evidence.excerpt: To bridge this gap, we introduce MCR-Bench, the first defect state-aware benchmark designed for realistic multi-round code review.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Although recent work explores large language models (LLMs) for automated code review, most approaches oversimplify code review into a single-round, static decision task, which fails to capture the multi-round interactive nature and the complex problem-solving processes inherent in realistic review scenarios.
